title: Spawning
description: Ships and objects that arrive by themselves, and where new objects are placed. The feature document, spawning.md, is the primary record.

entities.name: Space fills up by itself
entities.description: Every time the main counter reaches 0, something may arrive.
entities.behavior: When the main counter reaches 0 and the player is not dying, one byte chooses between a benign spawn (a trader, an asteroid or a canister) and a hostile one: police for contraband or a record, then pirates, a pack, a lone hunter or the aliens, as the system's government and the spawn delay allow. Nothing spawns in the Deep, and no rocks or hostiles in the safe zone.
entities.outcome: The space around the pilot is alive, and more dangerous under weak governments.
constraints: GOVERNMENT_STOP_FROM and PACK_FROM bound the hostile rolls.
A full bubble takes nothing; the draws are still spent.
Draws come from the main generator in RULES' order.

entities.name: Placements
entities.description: Where new objects appear: the hostile template, the alien group, a launch straight ahead and a ship's children.
entities.behavior: The template places a hostile arrival from drawn bytes; the alien group is a mothership and a drone at one place; a launch straight ahead puts an object in front of the player; children copy their parent and leave a station along its nose.
entities.outcome: Arrivals appear where the rules say, so the game replays exactly.

relatedViews.relationship: The pilot's goals that exercise it.
Runs the arrivals' AI and launches their children.
